status: Post-audit descriptive extension; thresholds and analyses are not preregistered confirmation tests
selection: First primary-threshold alarm in each session; retain sessions whose first alarm had observed outcome resumed. One record per selected session.

extra_energy_after_first_resumption.definition: From first resumed row until before first UNPLUGGED, first >15 s/non-increasing gap, missing current, missing/negative power, or file end. Excludes the final interval to unplug. Includes subsequent low/high current segments within that observed window.

limitations: Selected on observed recovery; not a population recovery probability or general event-rate estimate.
Discrete observed high span does not prove continuous analog current stayed above threshold between samples.
End-point minimum quadrature is conservative relative to trapezoidal integration but is not a certified lower bound on the unobserved physical path.
A short first high segment can be followed by further recovery; energy describes the entire later continuous observation window, not only that first segment.
Counter comparison rejects internal decreases and excludes terminal reset. No full-session maximum or negative reset increment is used.
Magnitude alone does not establish control benefit, unmet demand, battery state, or a failure of the deployed controller.
